caption: The drawing depicts a single chair set against a plain, light beige background. The chair is made of dark brown wood and features elaborate and ornate carvings on its high backrest and lower supports. The backrest has three vertical slats in the center, flanked by two intricately carved scroll and leaf patterns. The chair's joints and legs are turned and decorated, with additional horizontal and scrollwork stretchers connecting the legs. The seat of the chair is rectangular and light tan in color, appearing to be made of woven cane. The chair is drawn with detailed shading to indicate depth and contour, and there is an artist's signature in the bottom left corner of the image.
title: High Back Side Chair
